correctness.rationale: Using all ordered pairs, a diagonal word has bipartite link with one incoming and one outgoing side. For an off-diagonal overlapped edge ab,bc the common neighbors are bb and ca if a differs from c, or aa and bb otherwise; in either case they are nonadjacent. Thus no four-clique exists, all edges lie in the diagonal-star union, and the omitted triangles are the two cyclic orientations on each alphabet triple. The closed diagonal stars are cones and intersect pairwise in the edge ab--ba, with no triple intersections. Their good-cover nerve is the unfilled complete graph. Explicitly, on barycentric subdivision the map assigning each face the set of stars containing it is an inclusion-reversing nerve map; on a cyclic boundary it traces the three subdivided nerve edges because its vertices lie in the respective pair intersections. Attaching maps may therefore be transported across the nerve equivalence. The CW model has two disks attached around each alphabet triangle; one per triple gives the simply connected simplex two-skeleton when q>=3, and q=2 gives an interval. Root-triangle boundaries span the integral graph cycle lattice, of rank binomial(q-1,2). The kernel in degree two is free of rank 2 binomial(q,3)-binomial(q-1,2); the homology isomorphism from Hurewicz representatives is a homotopy equivalence by Whitehead. This verifies the unrestricted q proof without using finite-field ranks to infer integral homotopy.
residual_risks: The argument includes repeated words and depends on a simple, undirected graph; it does not extend by inference to directed flags, multigraphs, observed subsets, or longer word lengths.

value.rationale: A natural entire family of short-word transition graphs gains a tractable homotopy model after flag filling, not merely a graph-cycle count. The argument explains which cycles die via triangular fillings and why independent sphere classes remain, with an exact first noncontractible case at three letters. This provides an exact topology benchmark for word-overlap models without claiming the analogous result for longer words.
residual_risks: No claimed extension to higher word length or incomplete alphabets of observed words.
